notes: Stop Program Change numbers are not published per stop for this model (the manual only says they depend on the number and order of the stops): use Learn every stop. Each stop Program Change toggles the stop.

Check on your organ: the division channels can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu. The manual does not say which channel carries CC11 (expression) or CC7 (general volume): CC11 is assumed on the Swell's channel and CC7 on channel 1.
Romantic, Symphonic and Baroque styles share the same stop names; the stop names are from the 2005 brochure. Pedalboard 30-note (27-note on smaller models).
The English Rembrandt 275/375/395/495 manual was not found (only French/German); the MIDI scheme is from the English Rembrandt AGO manual of the same generation.

Stop list: Johannus brochure "BDO - Studio - Opus - Sweelinck - Rembrandt" (EN, 2005): https://hq.globalorgangroup.com/service/scripts/customer.fcgi/getAttachment/38439-tiXQiYHABCGx1srr6NqAYkq1LSB42aqJ833skbYao9WUygMY9AktuxCSHaEOyGy6-0/Brochure%20BDO%20-%20Studio%20-%20Opus%20-%20Sweelinck%20-%20Rembrandt%20EN.pdf
